ctx.x: So Willie took me in the car and Little Brother was in the car and , he was a good drummer. He really was a good drummer. He played that drum and another -- Junior was -- played the harmonica, he went. It was some of us went and came from Louisiana and Big Billie (PHONETIC) come from Louisiana, you know.
But that was the first time you ever met Little Brother?
